Michael Jackson's "Thriller" jumped 59 places to No.17 on Spotify's global weekly chart (week ending Nov 5, 2026): 16.9M streams, up 6.56M in a week, its highest position in 22 weeks on the chart.

A 1982 song carried by Halloween week, and it brought company: "Billie Jean" is No.21 and "Beat It" No.48. Michael Jackson has 91.6M monthly listeners on Spotify (Nov 9, 2026).

Halloween song, or a classic that never really left?

Data: Spotify global weekly chart via kworb · Nov 5-9, 2026
